audit_items.proof_trace: The borrow-safety path enforces EMA-spot tolerance via `get_price_with_check` (x_oracle/sources/entry_points/user.move:42-59), which aborts if `|EMA-spot|/spot > tolerance`; Pyth prices are published from off-chain validators into immutable `PriceInfoObject` refs and cannot be altered within a single Sui transaction, so flash-loan manipulation of Pyth EMA is not possible. Liquidation-eligibility uses EMA-only (inherently manipulation-resistant), and confidence bounds plus staleness checks are enforced at refresh time in `pyth_adaptor.move`.
